sentences.text: Bretesuchus was a large apex predator reaching a total length of approximately 4 meters.
Its name combines the local site with the Greek word souchos, an Egyptian crocodile god.
The specific name honors Jose Bonaparte.
Zulma Gasparini, Marta Fernandez, and Jaime E. Powell named the species in 1993.
Remains were discovered in the El Brete locality within the Maíz Gordo Formation of northwestern Argentina.
It is classified within the family Sebecidae.
In 2007, a related species was reclassified as a bretesuchid and assigned to its own genus, Zulmasuchus.
The animal lived during the Thanetian stage, from 59.24 to 56 million years ago.
Recent phylogenetic analyses suggest that the family Bretesuchidae nests deeply within Sebecidae and is therefore synonymous with it.
